answers.contribution: All parity-permitted real fibre counts and a selected fold-adjacency chain for one explicit map in every degree, on the stated open locus.

answers.limitations: Only C nonzero and nonzero discriminant; not all fibres or the whole adjacency graph; rational witness selection need not have closed formulas.
answers.obstacles: Initial PDF omitted a short justification that the tangent parametrization is finite and birational; supplied in the follow-up. No demonstrated theorem failure.
